title: The Architecture of Technical Deflation: Scaling Vermont's Healthcare Infrastructure gemini5
summary: This analysis explores the concept of technical deflation within the Vermont Agency of Digital Services. It evaluates how reducing the cost of data liquidity through standardized interoperability fabrics can reinvest capital into direct patient care outcomes.

children.text: Technical deflation is the primary catalyst for sustainable healthcare transformation. By streamlining the interoperability fabric, we reduce the recurring 'tax' of legacy system maintenance.

body.title: Briefing: Reinvesting the Deflationary Dividend
body.summary: An executive briefing on capital reallocation strategies following the VHIE modernization.

children.text: We do not save money by cutting services; we save money by removing the friction that makes services expensive.
